import re
import os
import hashlib
import tempfile
import json
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Model metadata schema validation patterns
# These patterns validate model card format compliance
METADATA_VALIDATORS = {
    "model_name": re.compile(r'^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,63}$'),
    "version": re.compile(r'^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$'),
    "framework": re.compile(r'^(tensorflow|pytorch|onnx|sklearn)$'),
}

# Validates structured description fields in model cards
# Format: key=value pairs separated by semicolons, values can be quoted
DESCRIPTION_FIELD_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r'^([a-zA-Z_]+\s*=\s*(?:"[^"]*"|[^;]*)(?:;\s*[a-zA-Z_]+\s*=\s*(?:"[^"]*"|[^;]*))*);?$'
)

# Layer specification pattern for model architecture descriptions
# Matches patterns like: "dense(128)->relu->dense(64)->softmax"
LAYER_SPEC_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r'^(?:[a-z]+(?:\([^)]*\))?(?:->)?)+$'
)


@dataclass
class ModelUpload:
    """Represents a validated model upload request."""
    name: str
    version: str
    framework: str
    description: str
    architecture: str
    file_hash: str
    file_path: Path
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


class InputSanitizer:
    """Sanitizes and validates all user-provided inputs."""
    
    MAX_FIELD_LENGTH = 4096
    MAX_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH = 8192
    
    @staticmethod
    def check_length(value: str, max_len: int, field_name: str) -> str:
        if len(value) > max_len:
            raise ValueError(f"{field_name} exceeds maximum length of {max_len}")
        return value
    
    @staticmethod
    def sanitize_basic(value: str) -> str:
        """Remove null bytes and strip whitespace."""
        return value.replace('\x00', '').strip()


class ModelCardValidator:
    """Validates model card metadata according to ML model registry spec."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.sanitizer = InputSanitizer()
        # Precompiled tag validation - matches hierarchical tags
        # e.g., "nlp/classification/sentiment" or "cv/detection/yolo"
        self._tag_pattern = re.compile(
            r'^(?:[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:/[a-z][a-z0-9]*)*(?:,\s*)?)+$'
        )
    
    def validate_name(self, name: str) -> str:
        name = self.sanitizer.sanitize_basic(name)
        name = self.sanitizer.check_length(name, 64, "model_name")
        if not METADATA_VALIDATORS["model_name"].match(name):
            raise ValueError("Invalid model name format")
        return name
    
    def validate_version(self, version: str) -> str:
        version = self.sanitizer.sanitize_basic(version)
        version = self.sanitizer.check_length(version, 20, "version")
        if not METADATA_VALIDATORS["version"].match(version):
            raise ValueError("Invalid version format")
        return version
    
    def validate_framework(self, framework: str) -> str:
        framework = self.sanitizer.sanitize_basic(framework).lower()
        if not METADATA_VALIDATORS["framework"].match(framework):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported framework")
        return framework
    
    def validate_description(self, description: str) -> str:
        """Validate structured description field."""
        description = self.sanitizer.sanitize_basic(description)
        description = self.sanitizer.check_length(
            description, InputSanitizer.MAX_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH, "description"
        )
        # Validate structure if it looks like a structured description
        if '=' in description and ';' in description:
            if not DESCRIPTION_FIELD_PATTERN.match(description):
                raise ValueError("Invalid structured description format")
        return description
    
    def validate_architecture(self, architecture: str) -> str:
        """Validate model architecture specification string."""
        architecture = self.sanitizer.sanitize_basic(architecture)
        architecture = self.sanitizer.check_length(
            architecture, InputSanitizer.MAX_FIELD_LENGTH, "architecture"
        )
        if architecture and not LAYER_SPEC_PATTERN.match(architecture):
            raise ValueError("Invalid architecture specification")
        return architecture
    
    def validate_tags(self, tags: str) -> str:
        """Validate hierarchical tag string."""
        tags = self.sanitizer.sanitize_basic(tags)
        tags = self.sanitizer.check_length(tags, 1024, "tags")
        if tags and not self._tag_pattern.match(tags):
            raise ValueError("Invalid tag format")
        return tags


class InferenceServer:
    """ML Model inference server handling model uploads and predictions."""
    
    ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {'.onnx', '.pt', '.h5', '.pkl'}
    MAX_FILE_SIZE = 500 * 1024 * 1024  # 500MB
    
    def __init__(self, storage_dir: str = "/tmp/models"):
        self.storage_dir = Path(storage_dir)
        self.storage_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.validator = ModelCardValidator()
        self.models: Dict[str, ModelUpload] = {}
    
    def _compute_file_hash(self, file_path: Path) -> str:
        """Compute SHA-256 hash of uploaded file."""
        sha256 = hashlib.sha256()
        with open(file_path, 'rb') as f:
            for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b''):
                sha256.update(chunk)
        return sha256.hexdigest()
    
    def _validate_file_extension(self, filename: str) -> str:
        """Validate file has allowed extension."""
        ext = Path(filename).suffix.lower()
        if ext not in self.ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
            raise ValueError(f"File extension {ext} not allowed")
        return ext
    
    def upload_model(self, request_data: Dict[str, Any], file_path: str) -> ModelUpload:
        """Process a model upload request with full validation."""
        
        # Validate all metadata fields
        name = self.validator.validate_name(request_data.get('name', ''))
        version = self.validator.validate_version(request_data.get('version', ''))
        framework = self.validator.validate_framework(request_data.get('framework', ''))
        description = self.validator.validate_description(
            request_data.get('description', '')
        )
        architecture = self.validator.validate_architecture(
            request_data.get('architecture', '')
        )
        
        # Validate optional tags
        tags = request_data.get('tags', '')
        if tags:
            tags = self.validator.validate_tags(tags)
        
        # Validate file
        file_p = Path(file_path)
        if not file_p.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError("Upload file not found")
        
        file_size = file_p.stat().st_size
        if file_size > self.MAX_FILE_SIZE:
            raise ValueError("File exceeds maximum size")
        
        self._validate_file_extension(file_p.name)
        file_hash = self._compute_file_hash(file_p)
        
        # Store model
        model = ModelUpload(
            name=name,
            version=version,
            framework=framework,
            description=description,
            architecture=architecture,
            file_hash=file_hash,
            file_path=file_p,
            metadata={'tags': tags}
        )
        
        model_key = f"{name}:{version}"
        self.models[model_key] = model
        logger.info(f"Model {model_key} uploaded successfully")
        
        return model
    
    def get_model(self, name: str, version: str) -> Optional[ModelUpload]:
        """Retrieve a registered model."""
        name = self.validator.validate_name(name)
        version = self.validator.validate_version(version)
        return self.models.get(f"{name}:{version}")
